name: ortho-globe
description: The globe's own pages, with no region: Globe ⇄ Equal Earth, world earthquakes, satellites, clouds, physical geography, US national parks, a world clock, world population in hexagons and arcs (the shortest way). Served at www.ortho-earth.com/globe/.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run verify:prod && npm run deploy:built
scripts.test: node tests/t-hex-pop.mjs && node tests/t-quakes-reader.mjs && node --test tests/t-clock.mjs tests/t-arcs-data.mjs
